yt_title: Meet Myra: describe it, it builds it ✨ #Shorts
yt_description:
Meet Myra, a conversational AI that builds anything in Stackby. Just ask.

Describe what you need and Myra builds it: databases, automations, interfaces and portals, AI field agents, formulas, even web search. Add your spreadsheets and Myra turns them into a working database and app.

In this video, Myra turns projects.xlsx into a client project tracker with a budget formula, a Slack alert for at-risk projects and a client portal, from one prompt.

What Myra builds
• Databases and linked tables
• Automations and workflows
• Interfaces and client portals
• AI field agents and formulas
• Tables from web search
